title: Lawrence County eliminated at Tenn. state tournament | Sports | timesdaily.com
text:
MURFREESBORO, Tenn. — Covington scored five seventh-inning runs to beat Lawrence County 19-15 on Wednesday and eliminate the Wildcats from the Class 3A state tournament.
